generation_policy: 262144 minus actual tokenized prompt length, including special tokens; EOS can terminate sooner

startup_policy.interpretation: Conservative launch policy, not a measured guarantee. Sequential fallback preserves the native length protocol.

prior_short_run.interpretation: PyTorch per-process allocated peaks; not whole-device peak and not a native-length memory measurement.

checks: Loaded model config must report native context 262144.
Each prompt is tokenized without silent truncation.
generate receives 262144 minus actual prompt token count.
Resume, merge and analyzer validate per-row budget and unchanged protocol identities.
Reaching the limit without EOS is retained as truncated; errors are not scored as incorrect answers.

limitations: KV arithmetic excludes weights, recurrent/conv states, activations, attention temporaries, CUDA context and allocator reserve.
Two-worker arithmetic supports plausibility only; full native-length generation has not run on GPU.
Prompts remain short; generation grows the cache token by token. Long-context attention temporary allocation and latency still depend on actual backend behavior.
An increased cap permits longer answers but does not force generation to the cap and cannot guarantee zero truncation.
Completed answers are resumable; an interrupted in-flight answer must restart from its recorded seed.
Native context changes the evaluation budget from the prior 1024-token screen, so scores must be reported as a new protocol.
source_access: Pinned local config matched recorded official git blob; no new remote document was used.
